description: Pinned reference corpus for the structural query latency budget and scaling gate (issue #120): reuses the issue #255 fixture source (a snapshot of Egregore's own src/query/ subsystem, 51 Rust files, plus a minimal Cargo.toml), scanned with a pinned transaction time and repository identity. Representative of a single crate's code graph; the benchmark records actual 1x/10x record counts in every report so corpus size stays auditable even as the extractor evolves. Deterministic synthetic SemanticDrift nodes are appended per repo copy so `eg query drift` has a stable answer on the fixture.
reference_machine_class: GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest runner (the CI gate). Local runs on a 2-CPU sandbox VM measured cold p50 ~0.5s unloaded, ~1.0-1.5s under heavy load; the scaling assertion is relative (machine-independent) while the absolute p95 budget is advisory.
